title: Can LLM Agents Discover? Evaluating Creativity on ML Engineering Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2608.30047v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent AI systems promise autonomous scientific discovery, claiming to discover algorithms and produce research papers, yet understanding whether they exhibit creativity, the capacity to produce solutions that are both novel and useful, remains an open question. We present a framework for evaluating multi-turn LLM research agents' creativity using ML engineering tasks as a testbed, through three dimensions: P-Creativity (psychological novelty: novel relative to the agent's own prior solutions within a run), H-Creativity (historical novelty: novel relative to the corpus of human solutions), and Usefulness (task performance). Evaluating two agent frameworks, AIDE and AIRA-Dojo, on 10 Kaggle-style machine learning tasks from MLE-Bench, we develop an LLM-as-a-Judge pipeline and verify its strong correlation with human creativity judgments, providing a reliable automated metric for P-Creativity evaluation at scale. translated_title: LLM智能体能够实现科学发现吗？在机器学习工程任务上评估创造力
translated_abstract: 近年来的AI系统承诺实现自主科学发现，声称能够发现算法并产出研究论文，然而它们是否展现出创造力——即产生既新颖又有用的解决方案的能力——仍是一个悬而未决的问题。我们提出了一个评估多轮LLM研究智能体创造力的框架，以机器学习工程任务作为测试平台，从三个维度进行评估：P-创造力（心理新颖性：相对于智能体在同一次运行中自身先前解决方案的新颖性）、H-创造力（历史新颖性：相对于人类解决方案语料库的新颖性）以及有用性（任务性能）。我们在来自MLE-Bench的10个Kaggle风格机器学习任务上评估了两个智能体框架AIDE和AIRA-Dojo，开发了LLM-as-a-Judge（大语言模型作为裁判）评估流程，并验证了其与人类创造力判断之间具有很强的相关性，为大规模P-创造力评估提供了可靠的自动化指标。将该流程应用于……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个从P-创造力、H-创造力和有用性三个维度评估LLM研究智能体在机器学习工程任务上创造力的框架，并开发了与人类判断高度相关、可规模化应用的LLM-as-a-Judge自动化评估流程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework for evaluating LLM research agents' creativity on ML engineering tasks across three dimensions—P-Creativity, H-Creativity, and Usefulness—and develops an LLM-as-a-Judge pipeline that strongly correlates with human creativity judgments, enabling reliable automated evaluation at scale.
